cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Find the Real Authority
cards.instruction: Probe until you know who can approve, block, or reverse the outcome.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. The pipe's still leaking. Which signature releases the repair money?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: All three. I've spent all morning getting them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Could anyone still freeze it after your morning's work?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Finance could. Though they unfroze the roof payment when the caretaker called.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: What did the caretaker have: permission to overrule finance, or someone else's direct number?

mechanism: A corrects the assumption that collected signatures release funds, then tests whether a caretaker has actual override authority or access to it.
confusable: D42 might pursue a simple practical solution; D54 specifically maps who can block or reverse approval.
comparison: Trip alternative tests delegated payment power; leak alternative follows evidence of a previous freeze reversal.
seedUse: Leaking pipe, three signatures, finance freeze and caretaker roof call derive from D54-b; S03 adds authority-verification corrections.
